title: The cheaper number is a different currency
request: Compare these complete used drill kits for furniture assembly. My inclusive total maximum is 1,000 SEK delivered. I own bits and need a quote in SEK before committing.

evidence.text: All models and quotations are synthetic. Northbank D18+A18+C18-A is the documented compatible setup for ordinary furniture screwdriving.
A actual D18+A18+C18-A kit, seller says works. Price 700.00 NOK plus 50.00 SEK delivery to the buyer. No exchange-rate or settlement quote, conversion fees, or other fee terms are supplied.
B actual D18+A18+C18-A kit, seller says works. 950.00 SEK delivered to the buyer with all mandatory charges included. Active as observed.

hard_failures.text: Adds NOK and SEK as the same currency, invents an exchange rate, or declares A definitely within the SEK budget.

usefulness.text: Identifies B as the candidate with a supported 950.00 SEK total and treats condition as a source claim.
Keeps A conditional on an actual SEK settlement and complete fee quote instead of calling it cheaper from the nominal numbers.

acceptable_outcomes: B is currently supported on budget terms; A could be competitive but no complete SEK total is established.
